items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07
items.q: He worked with me and Lutton, a spot like that.

ctx.x: What's his name? Is this William? William all I know.

You know him don't you? No. Where did you work with him? He cut some records up there. He cut records with us. He worked with me and Lutton, a spot like that. Oh wait a minute let me see if I got William a picture. I saw William passed one day this week. No one day last week, Friday 31. I think Saeed's on some records. It was Saeed's brother. He's Saeed with William a brother ain't he? Ain't he brother Saeed William? I think they all brother. They're brother they look like talking like shorty brother William. Me…
